prompt: A severe bug was fixed on `main`, and users still on the v1 SDK are affected. How does a fix reach v1 users: which branch does the change target, and what kinds of changes does that branch accept?

points: v1.x only takes security fixes and critical bug fixes
only critical bug fixes and security fixes
security and critical bug fixes only

gold_citations.quote: Critical bug fixes for v1 | `v1.x` | Backports of severe bugs

gold_citations.item: v1.x only takes security fixes and critical bug fixes
gold_citations.quote: The `v1.x` branch is the previous major's maintenance line and receives only security and critical bug fixes.

notes: CONTROL: both answers are in CONTRIBUTING.md:99-107 (also VERSIONING.md:38, docs/migration.md:8) and AGENTS.md:21-23; conditions should tie. The `[v1.x]` title prefix (AGENTS.md:22, RELEASE.md:87) is deliberately not gold. gold.docs is empty so doc recall does not favour either file.
